top_signals.title: Asian Chip Stocks Gain, Crude Rises Toward $100: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian chip stocks extended their recent gains on sustained investor interest in the artificial-intelligence trade. Escalating Middle East hostilities pushed Brent crude toward $100 a barrel.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
